en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty-Section The Twenty-second Chapter
The Discourse on the Realization of the Dhamma:
Is there realization of the Dhamma while lying in the womb?
Yes, there is.

Is there, while lying in the womb, the teaching of the Dhamma, the hearing of the Dhamma, discussion of the Dhamma, questioning about the Dhamma, the undertaking of moral discipline, guarding of the sense faculties, moderation in eating, and devotion to wakefulness during the first and last watches of the night?
One should not say so... [and so on] ...

Is it the case that, while lying in the womb, there is no teaching of the Dhamma, no hearing of the Dhamma... [and so on] ... no devotion to wakefulness during the first and last watches of the night?
“Yes.

[The opponent asks: “If there is no teaching of the Dhamma for one lying in the womb, nor listening to the Dhamma, nor the practice of wakefulness during the first and last watches of the night, then indeed you should not say:
‘There is the realization of the Dhamma while lying in the womb.’”
Is there the realization of the Dhamma while lying in the womb? Yes.
But are there not two conditions for the arising of right view?
And does one [also] have the voice of another and wise attention?
Yes. If so, there are indeed two conditions for the arising of right view.
There is the voice of another and wise attention, yet indeed it should not be said:
"There is the realization of the Dhamma while lying in the womb.
Is there realization of the Dhamma while lying in the womb?
“Yes,” you say.
But can it be said that there is a realization of the Dhamma for one who is heedless, negligent, unmindful, and lacking clear comprehension?
Certainly not; such should not be said … [and so on] …
The Discussion on the Realization of the Dhamma is finished.
